entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He frowns in mock disappointment, as he presses a button on his stylish coat; it hisses, and you hear motors whirring*#WHITE#
Oh, what a pity.  Guards?  Ten thousand gold to whoever gets the killing blow.  Store credit, of course.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他假装失望地皱起眉头，按下外套上的按钮。它发出嘶嘶声，你听见引擎的轰鸣。*#WHITE#
真遗憾。警卫？谁杀了他，就有一万金的赏钱。当然，只能在本店消费。

entries.source: Nektosh claims he is the invincible, omnipotent descendant of a unicorn, but I don't believe that bull for a second.  While the great magical power that suddenly awakened within him is as fearsome as it is insanity-inducing,  he has yet to use it to make a shield or teleport himself, and even with his all-powerful beam, his aim isn't always perfect...  I think he has a weakness he's trying to hide.  Fight with courage, fellow Whitehoof, and the Krimbul Clan may be free once more!
entries.target: 独角者纳克托什声称他是无可战胜无所不能的独角兽后裔。但他说的每一句话我都不信。尽管他体内突然觉醒的魔法力量既强大得可怕又令人疯狂，但他还从未用它制造过护盾或传送自己；即便使用他那全能的射线，他的准头也不总是那么准……我想他有个想要隐藏的弱点。勇敢战斗吧，我的白蹄伙伴，克里布尔部族也许就能重获自由！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a tentaculous horror which you recognize for what it truly is. A living #{bold}#Sher'Tul#{normal}#!.*#WHITE#
Who are you, young creature, to stand up to a High Priest of Amakthel? Do you not know that you are before a servant of the Almighty Creator, the Sunfather, the God of Gods, Lord of all Eyal? In the millenia I have lived I have killed whole races like yourself. I have even wrenched the spirits of immortal gods from this world. So who are you, little one, who dare defy me?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*站在你面前的是一个长着触手的恐魔，你认出了他的真实身份：一个活着的 #{bold}#夏·图尔人#{normal}#!.*#WHITE#
站在阿马克泰尔的大祭司面前的年轻生物啊，你是谁呢？你难道不清楚，站在你面前的，是伟大的创造者、太阳之父、神上之神、埃亚尔的主人的仆从？千年以来，我曾终结过许多像你这样的种族，我甚至曾将不朽神明的灵魂从这世界扯出。小家伙，你认为自己是谁，竟敢违抗我？

entries.source: I... am %s, of the seed of Garkul the Devourer. Garkul taught us to fight legends, and to flinch not from even the most desperate deed. Here and now I face you without fear or hesitation, for the spirit of Garkul burns within me. And in his name I will #{bold}#break#{normal}# you!
entries.target: 我……名为%s，是吞噬者加库尔的后裔。加库尔教导我们挑战传奇，面对绝境也绝不退缩。此时此刻，我毫无畏惧与迟疑地面对你，因加库尔之意志在我体内燃烧。以他之名，我必将#{bold}#击垮#{normal}#你！

entries.source: I... am %s, though I lack my original body my mind is bound to Garkul the Devourer. Garkul taught us to fight legends, and to flinch not from even the most desperate deed. Here and now I face you without fear or hesitation, for the spirit of Garkul burns within me. And in his name I will #{bold}#break#{normal}# you!
entries.target: 我……名为%s，尽管失去了原本的躯体，我的精神仍与吞噬者加库尔紧密相连。加库尔教导我们挑战传奇，面对绝境也绝不退缩。此时此刻，我毫无畏惧与迟疑地面对你，因加库尔之意志在我体内燃烧。以他之名，我必将#{bold}#击垮#{normal}#你！

entries.source: I... am %s and I am not mortal! Garkul taught the orcs to fight legends, and to flinch not from even the most desperate deed. We learned that from them! Here and now I face you without fear or hesitation, for cold touch of undeath is within me. And I will #{bold}#break#{normal}# you!
entries.target: 我……名为%s，且我并非凡胎！加库尔教导兽人挑战传奇，面对绝境也绝不退缩。我们从他们身上学到了这些！此时此刻，我毫无畏惧与迟疑地面对你，因亡灵的冰冷触感在我体内流淌。我必将#{bold}#击垮#{normal}#你！

entries.source: I... am %s. Here and now I face you without fear or hesitation, for the utter determination burns within me. And I will #{bold}#break#{normal}# you!
entries.target: 我……名为%s。此时此刻，我毫无畏惧与迟疑地面对你，因决绝的意志在我体内燃烧。我必将#{bold}#击垮#{normal}#你！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you is an extremely old looking machine. It seems to be infused with some sort of psionic energy; impossible as this sounds.
And it #{bold}#speaks#{normal}# to you!*#WHITE#
Welcome @playername@. We have been waiting for you.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前的是一台非常古老的机器。它似乎充满了某种灵能，听上去不可思议。
现在，它朝你 #{bold}#说话#{normal}#了！*#WHITE#
你好啊@playername@，我们等你很久了。

entries.source: What do you need me for?
I have muscle tissue for you.
entries.target: 我有一些肌肉组织要给你。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*You feel a powerful presence in your mind.*#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*你感觉到脑海中有一个强大的存在。*#WHITE#

entries.source: Yes. We predict you will be useful to us. If you are not, another will be.
entries.target: 是的。我们预测你将对我们有所助益。如果你对我们无用，也会有其他人对我们有用。

entries.source:
We require recent yeti muscle tissue from powerful specimens. You will help us, or you will not. Either way they will come to us.
If you do so we shall reward you with petty knowledge so that you may postpone your death.
entries.target:
我们需要从强大的雪人个体身上取得新鲜的肌肉组织。你可以帮我们，也可以选择不帮；无论如何，它们都会到我们手上。
如果你帮了我们，我们会赏你一点微不足道的知识，好让你推迟死亡。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The muscle tissue suddenly vanishes from your inventory.*#WHITE#
Thank you @playername@, this is indeed a suitable specimen. We shall honor our bargain with you. What do you wish to learn?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*背包中的肌肉组织突然消失了。*#WHITE#
感谢你@playername@，这确实是一份合适的样本。我们会履行与你的约定。你想学什么？

entries.source: What do you wish to learn?
You cannot use your %s anymore; it is tainted by magic.
entries.target: 你不能再使用 %s，它已被魔法所污染。

entries.source:
Antimagic is a very special category. If you learn it you will never be able to use arcane powered items or talents again.
Do you still wish to take this path?
entries.target:
反魔法是一系非常特殊的技能。你学习后将不能使用奥术装备和法术技能。
确定要学习么？

entries.source: Select the party member to receive the reward:
entries.target: 选择队伍中获得奖励的成员：

entries.source: Very well. We can teach you a talent category; which do you want?
entries.target: 很好，我们能教你一个技能树；你想要哪种？

entries.source: Hum no let me change my mind.
Very well. We can teach you a talent.  Which do you want?
entries.target: 很好。我们能教授你技能。你想学哪个？

entries.source: Very well. We can teach you a talent; which type do you want?
entries.target: 很好。我们能教授你技能；你想学哪个？

entries.source:
Antimagic talents are very special. To learn one means you will never be able to use arcane powered items or talents again.
Do you still wish to take this path?
entries.target:
反魔法技能是非常特殊的。你学习后将不能使用奥术装备和法术技能。
确定要学习么？

entries.source: Very well. We can teach you a talent (unlocking the talent category is separate). Which do you want?
entries.target: 很好，我们可以教你一个技能（解锁该技能树是另一回事）。你想要哪个？

entries.source: Very well. We can increase one of your core stats by 4, which one?
entries.target: 很好，我们能让你的一项属性提高4点。你想选哪项？
前往工匠大师山洞的入口

entries.source: An ancient archive of knowledge! You've heard tales of those triangular store devices, holding items and restoring them. For a price.
entries.target: 一个古老的知识档案！你听说过那些三角形存储设备的故事：它们可以保存物品，也可以让人付费取回。

entries.source: A huge geothermal drill, pumping heat and steam from Eyal's crust.
entries.target: 一个巨大的地热钻，从埃亚尔的地壳中抽取热量和蒸汽。

entries.source: A little stockpile of herbs, whomever left them there should be thanked.
entries.target: 一小堆草药，不管是谁留在这里的，真应该谢谢他。

entries.source: #OLIVE_DRAB#You carefully pickup the stack of herbs.
